title: The scrotumtightening sea.
html_source:
O, what an adjective: scrotumtightening

Even in Joyce’s time, “shrinkage”—as experienced by Seinfeld’s George Costanza—was evidently a widely experienced phenomenon:

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BEnKLhi83J8
